original_card.question: Can a decoder deliver the local paid mass in fewer, larger-rank children (block frame climbs instead of rank-1 to rank-3 steps)?
methods: Find one exact small decoding identity whose frame path climbs in blocks, and price its complete per-call profile.
Bound the best effective child rank achievable for one fixed support alphabet, including copies, frames and restoration.
original_card.acceptance_gate: A per-call local profile, with all copied information, frames and restoration counted, whose ceiling exceeds the selected word's by at least 5%; masked or overcomplete supports must change an assumption of the eight-term all-pairs bound.

first_step.inspect: Read the selected word's per-call local profile, its packing ceiling and the lever table; run levers.py for the ideal budget of the lever you target.
first_step.scope: Positive control and planning budget only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Before any synthesis, write the candidate per-call local profile (and centre charge / unpaid coordinates if changed) and screen it with ceiling.ceiling(); reject it if even the ideal ceiling does not beat the selected word's by your stated margin. Ideal budget: rank-16 delivery is 2.31x (levers.py).
original_card.bottleneck_link: Rank-1 children are about half of recursive cost; the selected word's effective child rank is about 3.9. Larger-rank delivery lowers recursive cost per unit of paid mass.
allowed_variations: One masked, overcomplete or block decoder family with exact labels and supports.
A scoped lower bound on effective rank for one alphabet.
If the coverage law, template or guard changes, derive an applicable fully charged replacement bound instead of applying the incumbent ceiling outside its scope.
scope_change_triggers: Repacking idle remainders of an unchanged word (covered by the packing ceiling).
Repeating the eight-term all-pairs search inside its proved scope.

actual_scope: Masked P112 rank-one decoder terms with equal source/target F2 label spans and individual COPY rank at most four; arbitrary finite term count, complex coefficients, support sets and zero-cost corrections. Prove a complete COPY-rank and moment obstruction using the characteristic-zero lift of the binary mask.
scope_change_reason: This is the card's allowed scoped support-alphabet lower bound, not its positive construction gate. Matched support frames differ from the eight-term/all-pairs hypothesis and from PR1909's one-tetrad locality. The proof generalizes equal supports to equal label spans and tests the rank-four boundary explicitly.
bottleneck_link: A candidate can trade eight rank-eight centre copies for many low-rank masked copies. The proposed quotient bound tests whether matched-frame ranks one through four can lower the complete COPY moment before any helper or frame synthesis; all additional physical charges are optimistically waived, never declared free in an admitted supplier.
stop_rule: Stop construction if the exact characteristic-lift lower bound already dominates the incumbent COPY moment. Retain one proof/checker package only if the quantified proof, P112-specific sharp per-term witnesses and boundary controls pass; do not infer an exact decoder from the rank relaxation.
evidence: README.md proves the quantified common-span lift bound. CERTIFICATE.json records all 452 quotient forms, all 12544 P112 entries, sharp per-term capacity witnesses, matched unequal-support and hypothesis counterexamples, exact integer COPY84 relaxation, and the certified optimistic ceiling interval. verify.py supplies optimized-safe semantic controls.
author: Adam Gall
ai_assistance: Substantial OpenAI Codex (GPT-6 Astra) assistance in research, proof, implementation, experiments and documentation.

open_questions.question: Can unmatched support spans or rank-five matched terms realize a masked COPY profile below the incumbent after physical charges?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The proposed obstruction closes only matched support frames of COPY rank at most four, leaving the nearest changed interfaces explicit.
open_questions.first_step: Use exact support witnesses escaping the lift bound to formulate a small coefficient system on all constrained P112 entries, then screen its full cost before synthesis.
open_questions.blocked_by: A high-rank mask fixture is not a masked decoder; all coefficient equations and physical source, frame, restoration and hosting contracts remain.

optimistic_budget: Retain the selected non-COPY work and coverage assumptions; compare the candidate COPY moment with eight rank-eight copies, granting all new non-COPY charges zero. Target remains a ceiling at least 1.05 times the selected fixed-word ceiling. An obstruction is not achievement of that positive target.
